```{r}
library(reshape2)
library(sm)
library(lme4)
library(sjstats)
library(lsmeans)
library(Matching)
library(gplots)
library(stats)
```
```{r}
datum <- allRelevantData
```

```{r}
f55 <- allRelevantData[allRelevantData$simMetric == "50-55",]
f70 <- allRelevantData[allRelevantData$simMetric == "70-40",]
f90 <- allRelevantData[allRelevantData$simMetric == "90-10",]
f100 <- allRelevantData[allRelevantData$simMetric == "100-20",]

# Backup, just in case I do something stupid 
f55b <- f55
f70b <- f70
f90b <- f90
f100b <- f100

drops <- c("mTurkCode")
f55 <- f55[, !(names(f55) %in% drops)]
f55b <- f55
f70 <- f70[, !(names(f70) %in% drops)]
f70b <- f70
f90 <- f90[, !(names(f90) %in% drops)]
f90b <- f90
f100 <- f100[, !(names(f100) %in% drops)]
f100b <- f100

# RESHAPING SO THAT FOR EACH PARTICIPANT, THEIR RATING OF THE THREE CHOICES IS ON A DIFFERENT LINE 
f55l <- melt(f55, id.vars = c("ResponseId", "simMetric", "StateAcr", "Gender", "Education", "Race", "Age",  "Community", "PoliticalAffliation"))

f70l <- melt(f70, id.vars = c("ResponseId", "simMetric", "StateAcr", "Gender", "Education", "Race", "Age",  "Community", "PoliticalAffliation"))
f70l <- f70l[,c(1,10,11,2:9)]

f90l <- melt(f90, id.vars = c("ResponseId", "simMetric", "StateAcr", "Gender", "Education", "Race", "Age",  "Community", "PoliticalAffliation"))
f90l <- f90l[,c(1,10,11,2:9)]

f100l <- melt(f100, id.vars = c("ResponseId", "simMetric", "StateAcr", "Gender", "Education", "Race", "Age",  "Community", "PoliticalAffliation"))
f100l <- f100l[,c(1,10,11,2:9)]

# REORDERING COLUMNS IN f55l SINCE CURRENTLY ITS ORDERING IS DIFFERENT FROM THE CORDERING IN f70l, f90l, f100l 
f55l <- f55l[,c(1,10,11,2:9)]
```



```{r}
# PLOTTING THE DISTRIBUTIONS OF THE DIFFERENT DECISIONS FOR EACH SIMILARITY METRIC/TREATMENT

# TREATMENT 1

par(mar=c(5.1, 4.1, 4.1, 0.1), xpd=TRUE, cex.lab=1.5, cex.axis=1.5, cex.main=1.5, cex.sub=1.5)
sm.density.compare(f55l$value, f55l$variable, xlab="Fairness rating", lty = c(1,1,1))
axis(1, at=seq(1, 10, by=1))
title(main="Treatment 1: Distributions of the ratings for different decisions")
legend("topright",  bg = "transparent", legend=c("All A", "Equal", "Ratio"), col=c("red", "green", "blue"), lty=1:1, box.lty = 0, text.font=4)
```

```{r}
# PLOTTING THE MEANS OF THE DIFFERENT DECISIONS FOR EACH SIMILARITY METRIC/TREATMENT

# TREATMENT 1

plotmeans(f55l$value ~ f55l$variable, data = f55l, mean.labels = TRUE, n.label = FALSE, ci.label = TRUE, xlab = "Possible decisions to split the $50,000", ylab = "Workers' fairness rating", legend=c("All A", "Equal", "Ratio"))
title(main = "Treatment 1: Comparison of means (with 95% CI)")
```

```{r}
## T tests 

print("T Tests")
print("TREATMENT 1 (55/50)")

print("Give all money to A versus Split 50/50")
t55a <- t.test(f55b$`all A`,f55b$`split 50-50`, paired=T)
print(t55a)
print("Give all money to A versus Split in Ratio")
t55b <- t.test(f55b$`all A`,f55b$`split ratio`, paired=T)
print(t55b)
print("Split 50/50 versus Split in Ratio")
t55c <- t.test(f55b$`split 50-50`,f55b$`split ratio`, paired=T)
print(t55c)
```

```{r}
sd(f55b$`split 50-50`,na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}

# KS tests 
print("KS Tests")

print("TREATMENT 1 (55/50)")

print("Give all money to A versus Split 50/50")
ks55a <- ks.boot(f55$`all A`, f55$`split 50-50`, nboots=10000)
summary(ks55a)
print("Give all money to A versus Split in Ratio")
ks55b <- ks.boot(f55$`all A`, f55$`split ratio`, nboots=10000)
summary(ks55b)
print("Split 50/50 versus Split in Ratio")
ks55c <- ks.boot(f55$`split 50-50`, f55$`split ratio`, nboots=10000)
summary(ks55c)

```{r}
dat <- datum
drops <- c("mTurkCode")
dat <-dat[, !(names(dat) %in% drops)]
dat1 <- melt(dat, id.vars = c("ResponseId", "simMetric", "StateAcr", "Gender", "Education", "Race", "Age",  "Community", "PoliticalAffliation"))

dat1 <- dat1[,c(1,10,11,2:9)]
dat1b <- dat1
```

```{r}
mixed_lmm = lmer(value ~ simMetric*variable + (1|ResponseId),  data=dat1, REML = FALSE)
summary(mixed_lmm)
```

```{r}
Means <- lsmeans(mixed_lmm, specs = ~ variable | simMetric)
summary(Means)
```

```{r}
mixed_all = lmer(value ~ simMetric*variable + (1|ResponseId) + Education + Age + Race + PoliticalAffliation + Gender,  data=dat1, REML = FALSE)
summary(mixed_all)
```

```{r}

mixed_int = lmer(value ~ simMetric*variable*Education*Age*Race*PoliticalAffliation*Gender + (1|ResponseId),  data=dat1, REML = FALSE)
summary(mixed_int)
```



```{r}
lin = lm(value ~ simMetric*variable + (1|ResponseId) + Education, data=dat1)
summary(lin)
```
